title: Configure and Troubleshoot a DB Connect Data Source
objectives: Configure and Troubleshoot a DB Connect Data Source
Verify real recorded events, retained failures and current operational evidence.

tasks.instruction: Open Recorded integration operations → DB Connect. Inspect the actual failed unordered-query receipt and KV collection splunk_app_db_connect/dbx_db_input on sh01. The supplied v7_inventory checkpoint begins at zero; three fictional source database rows have not been indexed.

Repair native db_inputs.conf query to SELECT id, service, status FROM service_events WHERE id > ? ORDER BY id ASC. Keep mode=rising, connection=practice_db, tail_rising_column_name=id, tail_rising_column_number=1 and checkpoint_key=v7_inventory. Stage, restart virtual sh01 and poll. Confirm three actual indexed rows and KV checkpoint=3; another poll must not duplicate them.

Append fictional source row id=4, service=checkout, status=200 using the adapter control, then poll again. Confirm checkpoint=4 and Search index=db_logs | stats count dc(id) as ids returns count=4 and ids=4; inspect the job. Numeric unique ordered IDs avoid the timestamp-tie/skew issue. The bounded adapter never runs SQL/JDBC. Its KV document fields are teaching fields, not a claim of vendor checkpoint payload parity.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
